ns2:course.label: Medieval and Early Modern Literature
ns2:course.description: Overview of French literature from the Middle Ages to the Revolution in its historical context. Taught in French. Credit is not given for FR 209 and FR 301. Prerequisite: FR 211 and FR 212.
